title: Chapter 418 Sun God Fire
content:
Chapter 418 Sun God Fire

"I thought you had some big moves, but it turns out it's just a huge size, and it's very easy to deal with you." Zhong Yu said with a relaxed face.

Don't look at the tree demon's invincible appearance now, it seems that it can easily bury 100,000 troops when it is fully exerted, but it is hard to say what the actual situation is.

A large body means great strength, but at the same time, a large body also means that the speed is reduced. Although Zhong Yu does not deny that some perverts can take into account their body shape and at the same time cultivate their own speed to an incredible level.

But apparently, lumbering trees are not among this metamorphosis.

As a result, the tree demon's huge size is its biggest advantage, but it has an extremely fatal weakness.

That is, you cannot move.

Although the tree demon is big, with a height of over a thousand meters and a body width of hundreds of meters, others will feel small even if they stand in front of him and look up at the top of the tree, let alone wanting to destroy it. Then he felt admiration and fear in his heart, and thus completely lost his fighting spirit.

But think about it the other way around, as long as it stays away from the tree demon's attack range, no matter how big the tree demon is, it can do nothing to the enemy.

Among other things, let's just say that Zhong Yu's current army is separated at the outskirts of the forest, more than ten miles away from the tree demon's body.

Can such a long distance be reached by the tree demon's mere branches that are hundreds of meters long? Can't even get close to each other.

Therefore, the threat of the dryad body can basically be eliminated.

However, with the actions of the tree demon just now, apart from her own body, she actually had an extremely sharp attack.

That is the demon vine that was born with his body.

In fact, it is also clearly mentioned in the original book, but many people have not discovered it.

In Leslie Cheung's version of the movie, the dryad's conventional attack method is often to stick out his tongue, use him to entangle and hit the enemy.

In fact, this is not the tongue of a tree demon, but a tree vine that grows with him.

This sagitar grew together with the tree demon from the moment it was born, and now it has lived for thousands of years, almost the same as the tree demon.

For thousands of years, the dryad was able to grow from an ordinary tree into a sixth-level demon king, so naturally this demon vine could not fall anywhere, and it was also a sixth-level demon vine.

This can also explain why Yan Chixia, who has a superb cultivation base and is also a master of both Buddhism and Taoism, is so difficult to deal with the tree demon grandmother in the original work, and even falls into a disadvantage.

A tree demon grandma is already equivalent to the late sixth-order, plus a tree vine with a comparable cultivation, how can Yan Chixia, who is only the peak of the middle sixth-order, win, even if he has a profound inheritance.

After cultivating for so long, the tree vine and the tree demon have long been in a companion relationship. Both are prosperous and the other is damaged. No matter who dies, the other cannot survive alone.

Therefore, if Zhong Yu wanted to kill the tree demon with determination, the tree vines would also die along with the tree demon. How could this be possible.

Of course, the tree vine was not willing to be buried with the tree demon like this, and the deep relationship between the two of them for thousands of years would not allow him to sit back and watch the tree demon die.

So in this life-and-death struggle, it is only reasonable for the tree vine to make a move.

As a thousand-year-old tree vine, its body is also extremely huge, and its root system spreads, just like the previous tree demon, spreading over dozens of miles around.

Just like the skills of Yan Chixia and Ning Caichen in the original book, no matter where they go around in the woods, those tongues will always come out to attack.

However, this tree vine, like the tree demon just now, was seriously injured by the fire all of a sudden, and its strength was not small.

But all this is not a problem.

The dryad drew the life essence of all the surrounding trees. After that, as the tree vines that coexisted with the dryad, they were naturally nourished and got a share of the pie.

Under the support of these life energies, the vines not only recovered from their injuries, but also grew in size. The vines that originally covered dozens of miles around suddenly grew to a length of hundreds of miles, and the attack range covered the entire Guobei area. County, very scary.

That is to say, at this quarter of an hour, the army under Yu's command has also become unsafe, and may be attacked by tree vines at any time.

"Damn it, Your Majesty, the tree demon is dangerous, so let's get rid of it earlier. Those large troops should withdraw as soon as possible to avoid unnecessary casualties." Seeing that she was covered in cold sweat, Yan Chixia hurriedly persuaded Zhong Yu.

This time, the dryad was desperate in the crisis of life and death. He didn't care what his future outcome would be. He just wanted to drag the enemy to die with him.

Under the circumstances of such a desperate eruption, even if Yan Chixia boasted of extraordinary strength and really rushed to the tree demon, she would not dare to say that she would be able to retreat unscathed.

Even Yan Chixia couldn't deal with it, so the army under Zhong Yu's command, though large in number, was far beyond their opponents at this level, and they couldn't be of much use.

No, it cannot be said that it is not useful.

If these large armies were really desperate, they would still be able to consume the tree demon to death in the event of heavy casualties.

But this is obviously not what Yan Chixia wants to see. Thousands of people died because of a dryad, even if these people were soldiers born for war, Yan Chixia couldn't feel heartache.

"Don't worry, it's just a little tree demon, it's very easy. Let's see my skills." Zhong Yu said very calmly.

Then, with a big hand, a huge layer of invisible hands formed on the top of the tree demon's head, that is, the top of the entire Guobei County, and gradually became thicker.

Even people far away in the county seat, or even people from other counties, can clearly see this extremely terrifying hand.

Everyone knew that the owner of this hand was an extremely powerful man.

"Taiyang Shenhuo, guide me." Zhong Yu's majestic voice resounded hundreds of miles around, causing all the souls to tremble, and couldn't help but kneel down to show their respect.

After the words fell, I saw the big sun hanging high above the sky, and the endless heat on it was gathering, and finally turned into a sacred and inviolable fire, which was extremely fierce and full of the meaning of burning everything.

This is what countless people have sung about, the sun is really hot.

As one of the top ten divine fires in the world, and the most fierce and domineering divine fire among them, the power of the Sun Divine Fire naturally goes without saying.

Even because of the majestic majesty and inviolable artistic conception of Shenhuo, it often has unimaginable miraculous effects when used to deal with evil spirits and ghosts.

Unfortunately, that tree demon is a big demon with high cultivation base, and he grew up by devouring soul and life and gathering countless blood demons.

Sun Shenhuo is most interested in this kind of prey full of evil.

Down below, the tree demon and tree vines suddenly became terrified when they saw the appearance of the Sun God Fire.
